name: bio-skills
description: Agent skills for the bioinformatics research-engineering chores that have no tool and need judgement. Pipeline: pipeline-triage (diagnose a failed run) and methods-writer (Methods + reproducibility record). Repo hygiene: repo-scaffold (scripts-only new repo) and commit-guard (pre-push data/secret/PII check). Genericity: genericity-lint (hardcoding + reusability review against a portable ARCHITECTURE.md contract). All propose, never execute. Ships git-guard (block secrets/data at commit) and genericity-guard (flag hardcoding after edits) hooks.
